GOODSINFO_INFECTIONITEM: Cause disasters in one's own world
GOODSDESC_HOSTINGITEM:
A small, white eye orb warmed by Bonfire.

Creates a DSSeamlessCoop session with open-world co-op,
shared progression, and removed multiplayer fog barriers.
GOODSDESC_JOININGITEM:
A small, blue crystalline eye orb prepared by Bonfire.

Joins a DSSeamlessCoop session from anywhere in Lordran and
keeps the journey alive through deaths and boss victories.
GOODSDESC_BREAKINITEM:
A small, red hot eye orb carrying a hostile signal.

Invades a DSSeamlessCoop session when invasions are enabled.
Bonfires and warping are restricted until the fight is settled.
GOODSDESC_LEAVINGITEM:
A small, black eye orb marked by DSSeamlessCoop.

Disbands the current Bonfire session and returns the world to
its own path.
GOODSDESC_GAMERULECHANGEITEM:
A mess of unbound papers kept beside the bonfire.

Changes world rules for the DSSeamlessCoop session, including
co-op scaling and party behavior.
GOODSDESC_INFECTIONITEM:
An old, scratched pendant of unknown use.

The origin of this pendant is unknown, but some sources describe
a missing pendant from the catacombs of Gravelord Nito.
GOODSDESC_CURSESIGILITEM:
A blood-red blossom growing around the darksign.

You can feel the roots of this plant directly feeding off you
GOODSDESC_SAVEREPAIRITEM: Used to revive certain NPCs that have died
